module_name: M5 — Windows local Ollama inference agent

parents.milestone: M5 — Windows local Ollama inference agent
parents.title: Capture current Windows host/GPU/Ollama/Codex inventory
parents.acceptance: Host ID, RAM/VRAM, model hashes, available context and security posture recorded; [ASEL-1.0] ASEL gate: deterministic default-deny authorization and task-scoped least privilege apply outside the LLM; retrieved/model-generated content is untrusted data and cannot grant tools; secrets stay out of prompts, logs and artifacts; relevant scan/negative-test evidence is attached; unresolved Critical/High findings block completion; STOP/PAUSE/quota cannot be bypassed. Windows device identity, OS firewall/endpoint protection, patch state and job leases are verified; Ollama remains loopback-only and capabilities are short-lived/revocable.
module_guardrails: Authenticated outbound Windows agent; Ollama stays loopback-only.
Use leases, idempotency keys and reconnect reconciliation.
Never expose unauthenticated Ollama or silently route sensitive data.
ASEL endpoint boundary: authenticated outbound transport, inbound deny, firewall/endpoint health, loopback-only Ollama and revocable job leases.

ASEL-1.0 is enforced by deterministic code, not model compliance; scanner exceptions are time-limited and owner-approved; active scanning is non-destructive and limited to inventoried owner-controlled assets.
special_instructions: Windows node must be authenticated and Ollama bound to localhost; never expose Ollama publicly.

parents.milestone: M5 — Windows local Ollama inference agent
parents.title: Test Windows failure modes including oversized Codex requests
parents.acceptance: Large context rejected safely; worker reports failure without crash loops; [ASEL-1.0] ASEL gate: deterministic default-deny authorization and task-scoped least privilege apply outside the LLM; retrieved/model-generated content is untrusted data and cannot grant tools; secrets stay out of prompts, logs and artifacts; relevant scan/negative-test evidence is attached; unresolved Critical/High findings block completion; STOP/PAUSE/quota cannot be bypassed. Windows device identity, OS firewall/endpoint protection, patch state and job leases are verified; Ollama remains loopback-only and capabilities are short-lived/revocable.
module_guardrails: Authenticated outbound Windows agent; Ollama stays loopback-only.
Use leases, idempotency keys and reconnect reconciliation.
Never expose unauthenticated Ollama or silently route sensitive data.
ASEL endpoint boundary: authenticated outbound transport, inbound deny, firewall/endpoint health, loopback-only Ollama and revocable job leases.

ASEL-1.0 is enforced by deterministic code, not model compliance; scanner exceptions are time-limited and owner-approved; active scanning is non-destructive and limited to inventoried owner-controlled assets.
